concept: Review and integration: what taking pride in your work feels like so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of taking your time, feeling proud of imperfect work, and fixing instead of quitting — which matters most to you?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what 'craftsmanship' means so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition connecting to at least one prior story
